title.narrative: Initiativ för att stimulera privata investeringar mot resurseffektivitet
Initiative to Stimulate Private Investment for Resource Efficiency- InSPIRE

description.narrative: *Detta bidrag klassificeras som ett typ A projekt enligt policymarkören för insatser som syftar till att stödja Team Sweden och den privata sektorn inom konfektions- och textilindustrin i Bangladesh.* InSPIRE är ett initiativ som syftar till att främja en övergång till en mer hållbar textilproduktion genom energieffektivisering och övergång till förnybar energi. Projektet bidrar med gåvomedel till innovativa idéer från de fabriker som är viktiga för sysselsättningen men som inte är de mest moderna och därmed ger upphov till stora utsläpp samt från företag som tillhandahåller energirelaterade tjänster.

*This contribution is tagged as a type A project in terms of the policy marker for contributing to Team Sweden/Private Sector in the ready-made garment/textile sectors in Bangladesh.* InSPIRE is an initiative aimed at promoting a transition to a more sustainable production in the RMG sector through energy efficiency and renewable energy. The project will provide grant funding for innovative ideas to factories that are important for employment opportunities but are not the most modern and thereby give rise to large emissions, as well as companies providing energy-related services.

The InSPIRE programme aims to achieve the following programme goal -
Programme Goal: Contribute to an inclusive, gender-responsive green transition in Bangladeshi RMG sector by advancing the adoption of renewable energy and energy efficiency measures, while strengthening the industry's competitiveness in the global apparel value chain.
The InSPIRE programme aims to achieve two short-term outcomes that enables the achievement of two medium-term outcomes. In line with the programme goal, the outcomes also focus on economic and environmental dimensions, while also integrating gender and social elements
- Short-term Outcome 1: Gender-responsive and socially responsible energy efficiency and renewable energy measures successfully implemented and managed by Tier-2 and Tier-3 RMG factories
- Short-term Outcome 2: ESCOs develop and offer energy efficiency and energy management solutions to Tier-2 and Tier-3 RMG factories
- Medium-term Outcome 1: Reduced reliance on non-renewable energy sources in Tier-2 and Tier-3 RMG factories
- Medium-term Outcome 2: Positive net return on investment from energy efficiency and renewable energy measures for Tier-2 and Tier-3 RMG factories
Short-term Outcome 2 also contributes to Short-term Outcome 1 as ESCOs will serve an additional number of Tier-2 and Tier-3 factories beyond the direct grantees through the programme.
In addition to the short- and medium-term outcomes, the programme is expected to contribute to the following overarching objectives in the climate finance and green transition ecosystem, through the crosscutting KEL component -
a) Gather evidence of potential financial incentives to invest in sustainable energy measures to build an environmentally sustainable, compliant, and competitive RMG industry.
b) Expand the market for technical services and adoption of energy-efficient practices by improving the information flow and connectivity among factories and national and international service and technology providers.
c) Enhance connectivity between factories and green financing institutions, while facilitating effective negotiations to create accessible and practical pathways for sustainable financing.
d) Generate key learnings and best practices that inform future adoption of energy efficiency and renewable energy initiatives among RMG factories.

1.3 - Införa nationellt lämpliga system och åtgärder för socialt skydd för alla, inklusive grundskydd, och senast 2030 säkerställa att de omfattar en väsentlig andel av de fattiga och de utsatta.

10.3 - Ensure equal opportunity and reduce inequalities of outcome, including by eliminating discriminatory laws, policies and practices and promoting appropriate legislation, policies and action in this regard.

10.3 - Säkerställa lika möjligheter och minska förekomsten av ojämlika utfall, bland annat genom att avskaffa diskriminerande lagstiftning, politik och praxis och främja lagstiftning, politik och åtgärder av lämpligt slag i detta hänseende.
7.2 - By 2030, increase substantially the share of renewable energy in the global energy mix.
7.2 - Till 2030 väsentligen öka andelen förnybar energi i den globala energimixen.
7.3 - By 2030, double the global rate of improvement in energy efficiency.
7.3 - Till 2030 fördubbla den globala förbättringstakten vad gäller energieffektivitet.

7.b - By 2030, expand infrastructure and upgrade technology for supplying modern and sustainable energy services for all in developing countries, in particular least developed countries, small island developing States and landlocked developing countries, in accordance with their respective programmes of support.

7.b - Till 2030 bygga ut infrastrukturen och uppgradera tekniken för att leverera moderna och hållbara energitjänster till alla i utvecklingsländerna, i synnerhet de minst utvecklade länderna och små önationer under utveckling.
8.2 - Achieve higher levels of economic productivity through diversification, technological upgrading and innovation, including through a focus on high-value added and labour-intensive sectors.
8.2 - Uppnå högre ekonomisk produktivitet genom diversifiering, teknisk uppgradering och innovation, bland annat genom att fokusera på sektorer med högt förädlingsvärde och hög arbetsintensitet.

9.3 - Increase the access of small-scale industrial and other enterprises, in particular in developing countries, to financial services, including affordable credit, and their integration into value chains and markets.

9.3 - Öka tillgången för småskaliga industriföretag och andra företag, i synnerhet i utvecklingsländerna, till finansiella tjänster, inklusive överkomliga krediter, samt deras integrering i värdekedjor och marknader.
